subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three stale pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should this grouped set of verified GitHub Action upgrades be approved for merge?
rationale: The protected security label and privileged workflow surfaces require an explicit owner decision even though official tags validate the proposed SHAs and the identified defects are mechanical.

options.title: Repair then approve
options.body: Keep the grouped bump, update all stale assertions, and approve it after clean exact-head validation.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex Action upgrades for narrower owner review.

options.title: Pause the bump
options.body: Retain the current pins if owners do not want the combined supply-chain update now.

recommendation.title: Repair then approve
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped bump, update all stale assertions, and approve it after clean exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest available `.github` CODEOWNER and has recent history in the affected workflow-guard area.
